> MiniLab is a beginner-friendly portable environmental monitoring device built around an ESP32. It will use sensors to measure real-world conditions such as temperature, humidity, and light intensity, then display the readings on a small OLED screen. I’m building it as my first hardware project to learn microcontrollers, sensors, breadboarding, I²C communication, embedded programming, circuit debugging, and basic enclosure design.
